Current assets/current liabilities (candidate ACT/LCT).
Book equity divided by market equity; candidate CEQ and PRCC_F×CSHO. Market-value date is unspecified.

Indicator for a merger/acquisition year; target/acquirer role and fiscal-year assignment are unspecified.
Indicator that DATADATE fiscal-year-end is not December.
Operating income after depreciation (candidate OIADP) divided by prior-year assets (candidate AT at t−1).
Indicator that pre-extraordinary/discontinued income is negative in t, t−1 or t−2, following detailed p. 11; the Table 1 wording conflict is flagged.
Indicator for Compustat-coded opinion other than standard unqualified; code classification unresolved.
Square root of current-auditor relationship years; historical start and counting convention are not specified.

High-litigation-risk industry indicator from SIC per Francis et al. (1994); paper omits the industry list/coding rule.

design_coverage.reason: The source reports t statistics based on coefficient standard errors but does not report a covariance correction or clustering scheme.

implementation_issues.description: The estimator within year-by-size-decile cells is not named. Size measure, decile breakpoints/reference population and winsorization population (whole sample or fit cell) are omitted; these choices affect the 110 fits and mean coefficients.
The table reports t statistics from coefficient standard errors but does not specify covariance estimator, correction or clustering.

Detailed p. 11 LOSS includes discontinued operations, while the Table 1 note on p. 15 says net income before extraordinary items. Select the detailed p. 11 definition, preserve iv_014, and flag this source conflict.
BTM is book equity divided by market equity, but the date for market equity is unspecified.
The paper cites Francis et al. (1994) for LITRISK but does not reproduce the industry list or SIC coding.
Calendar-dated SDC events need assignment to Compustat fiscal-year labels; MERGER target/acquirer treatment is also unspecified. CLIENT tenure has no stated historical start.
Audit Analytics COMPANY_FKEY is not linked to Compustat GVKEY; SDC issuer CUSIP/name rows are not shown joined through time-valid CIK/GVKEY history to the firm-year panel.
Continuous-variable winsorization at 1st/99th percentiles is stated, but the percentile reference population is not.

review_notes: The UAF sample is 54,545 firm-years before the separate later AQ screen to 37,461; the later AQ data screen was not imposed.
The paper reports means from 110 fits (2000–2010 × ten size deciles); per-cell N and size assignment recipe are not reported.
Shared exact probes confirm field presence only. No coordinator coverage confirmations were supplied; historical coverage is unverified.
Catalog checks included SDC M&A/new-issues tables, Audit Analytics FEED18/FEED19 event tables and CIK/CUSIP/GVKEY candidate links; they do not close the event or sample-firm links.
